videos.title: The Holiday Effect That Almost Nobody Catches
videos.description:
Cem Karsan points to something few traders account for: Thanksgiving and Christmas drive a stretch from November through to mid-January that carries the lowest volume-weighted period of the year. It isn’t just the market holidays themselves. It’s the weeks around Thanksgiving and the stretch over Christmas and New Year when people simply aren’t trading. Pair that compression with the open interest sitting in December and you get a powerful tailwind.
